import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
data = data.fillna(data.median(numeric_only=True))
# Survival-like analysis: correlate disease_progression with glucose/cholesterol
corr, pval = spearmanr(data['glucose_level'], data['disease_progression'])
median_progression = data['disease_progression'].median()
high_risk_ratio = (data['disease_progression'] > median_progression).mean()
print({'key': 'glucose_progression_corr', 'value': round(float(corr), 6)})
print({'key': 'high_risk_ratio', 'value': round(float(high_risk_ratio), 6)})

}
